A.reason: No defect or missing contractual rule is asserted.

B.reason: The governing business-day calendar was not established; confidential compliance appendices are not public. Future amendments and notices through settlement cannot yet be established.

C.reason: Per-trade-date source substitution, conditional void/collateral return and Rule 5.2 settlement actions exceed ClaimSpecV1. A scalar projection would omit material terms.

D.reason: The witnesses demonstrate declared model boundaries, not a newly discovered resolver implementation defect.

requirements.requirement: Strict USD Reference Volume > 100000000; equality is NO
requirements.basis: Exact Appendix A pp.5,7; exact bigint decimal comparison.

requirements.requirement: Ordinary USD 1/0 binary payout for the YES position
requirements.basis: Exact Appendix A p.8; this excludes exceptional dispositions.

requirements.requirement: All eligible Gemini Titan trades, fractional quantities and contract-specific settlement multipliers; cent-scale aggregate; no premium
requirements.basis: Exact Appendix A pp.5-6. Scalar observations can carry a trusted computed amount, but ClaimLint does not execute or check this aggregation. An audited offline computation can establish inputs; it does not add these invariants to the resolver.

requirements.requirement: Exhaustive eligible-publication list and exclusions, including cumulative, UTC-day, partner and multi-venue figures
requirements.basis: Exact Appendix A p.6. Source IDs can reject an undeclared publisher, but prose/provenance cannot distinguish an ineligible statistic falsely labelled with an eligible source/metric ID. Evidence normalization is a trust boundary.

requirements.requirement: Reported November 1-30 trade-date attribution; clock envelope is expected, not controlling
requirements.support: APPROXIMATED — NOT ACCEPTABLE FOR VERIFIED FIXTURE
requirements.basis: Exact Appendix A p.5. A period ID can name the month, but required fixed interval bounds alone cannot execute reported trade-date attribution. The derived DST envelope is explanatory; it is not silently bound as the real period.

requirements.requirement: Primary Market Data, secondary Trade Data, tertiary hourly top-level categories
requirements.basis: Exact Appendix A pp.6-7 establishes the tier ordering. This row covers only source identity/order, not the per-date application in PX07.

requirements.requirement: Fallback separately for each missing trade date, with completeness and disclosed substitutions
requirements.basis: Exact Appendix A p.7. Resolver selects one whole-period source/observation; it cannot compose primary dates with secondary/tertiary missing dates. The 30-date witness gives 110m vs a mistaken whole-source result of 60m.
Exact Appendix A pp.6-7 and Rule 5.2. Priority alone or automatically routing every disagreement to review does not implement the documented materiality/authority relationship.

requirements.requirement: 17:00 ET, second business day after period end; expiration at cutoff
requirements.basis: Exact Appendix A pp.7-8. Full Rulebook/Terms inspected but no governing business-day definition established. Dec 2 22:00Z is a conditional weekday derivation, not a verified contractual instant.

requirements.requirement: Publication-as-of cutoff, pre-cutoff corrections included, later corrections excluded
requirements.support: APPROXIMATED — NOT ACCEPTABLE FOR VERIFIED FIXTURE
requirements.basis: Exact Appendix A p.7. freezeAtDetermination demonstrates the ordinary clause for evidence already available by cutoff. The core additionally freezes evaluator availability, and has no separately modelled publication snapshot/retrieval record. Inclusive exact-cutoff whole-second treatment is an explicitly stated interpretation.

requirements.requirement: Changed/absent reports: next same-data means, optional other same-data publication, reasonable/unequivocal determination
requirements.basis: Exact Appendix A pp.7-8 C/E. Generic replacement events and fixed action policies do not determine these judgments or partial-data sufficiency.

Exact Appendix A pp.7-8 C/E. No VOIDED/collateral-return result or action exists. NO, UNDEFINED and REVIEW_REQUIRED are not this defined disposition. A general terminal collateral-return primitive could represent it, but would not satisfy the other gates.

requirements.requirement: Settlement by one business day following expiration, except review
requirements.support: APPROXIMATED — NOT ACCEPTABLE FOR VERIFIED FIXTURE
requirements.basis: Exact Appendix A p.8. One eligibility instant can describe a simplified ordinary path, not the complete settlement window and review-dependent lifecycle.

requirements.requirement: Final once effected, subject to Rule 5.2 reversal/amendment/resettlement and discretionary allocation
requirements.basis: Exact Appendix A p.8; Rulebook v4.0 Rule 5.2, printed p.40. No disruption adjudication/result, last-traded-price allocation or authenticated settlement amendment state. A named review route can request a human process but cannot faithfully calculate its possible dispositions or conditional finality.

requirements.requirement: Concurrent emergency/trade-review powers and dispute boundaries
requirements.basis: Rulebook Rules 2.8-2.9, 4.6-4.7, 5.2(f), Chapter 12. Term/expiration changes and exceptional settlement actions exceed the fixed spec. Order disputes/arbitration must not be substituted for a Rule 5.2 appeal.

gate.rule: Every settlement-material requirement must be SUPPORTED EXACTLY or SUPPORTED WITH JUSTIFIED GENERAL EXTENSION before VERIFIED_SUPPORTED_REAL_FIXTURE is permitted.
gate.reason: Adding VOIDED and per-date fallback would still leave material discretionary allocation, changed terms, partial-data sufficiency and conditional post-settlement finality unrepresented. No narrow extension establishes full support.
